rules.statement: A deed of donation by a Muslim grandmother to her grandchildren is revocable unless the deed explicitly states it as irrevocable.
rules.supporting_quote: "The proviso to section 3 of the Muslim Intestate Succession and Wakfs Ordinance (Cap. 50) was enacted for the special purpose of relieving Judges in Ceylon of the responsibility of solving these knotty problems. The proviso expressly states : ' . . . no deed of donation shall be deemed to be irrevocable unless it is so stated in the deed . . .' "
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 3 of the Muslim Intestate Succession and Wakfs Ordinance (Cap. 50)
